text.p: IndeNet Inc on Wednesday said its unit, Enterprise, signed a seven-year, $20 million contract to support TSMS Group, which provides television sales and marketing in London.
IndeNet said Enterprise will provide operations, software, technical and development services for TSMS and its clients by integrating TSMS's computer services group with Enterprise's.

"The business-critical nature of TSMS' computer operations have never been entrusted to an outside vendor, and we are pleased that our credentials have earned us this contract," Graeme Jenner, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
IndeNet provides television, radio and advertising industries with broadcast management software systems and integrated media support services.
